subject: The 2-minute setup you skipped
preview_text: What if you could skip the 20-minute audio tweak every time you plugged in headphones?
body_paragraphs: You plug in headphones. Open settings. Fiddle with volume. Adjust EQ. Repeat every single time. That's 20 minutes a week lost to the same ritual.
There's a faster way. One you probably ignored because it felt like effort. But once it's set, it's gone. Forever.

Open Volume Booster Pro. Tap the gear icon top right. Enable 'Auto-apply on headphone connect.' Set your boost level and EQ once. That's it. Next time you plug in, it's already perfect. Two minutes of setup, and the app steps back. No ads. No noise. Just the slider, working.
Try it now. Then forget it exists. P.S. — Premium users get to save multiple profiles. One for podcasts, one for music. Switch in a tap.
